notes: Clearer Auto-pilot banner when the server has acted. When your saved rules decide picks on the server overnight, the app places them as dated practice orders the moment it opens — and the banner used to say 'bought 3 shares' while also saying the bot 'hasn't run yet today', which read as a contradiction. It now says exactly what happened: 'placed 3 server-decided practice orders 🌐 your rules decided these at the market close; the app placed them on opening'. 'Last completed run' is now labelled 'Last completed local scan' for the same reason.
